syllabus.title: Introduction to Mechatronics and its Systems; Basics of Digital Technology
syllabus.body: Introduction to Mechatronics and its Systems: Evolution, Scope, Measurement Systems, Subsystems and integration of mechanical & electrical systems using computer based control, Control Systems, open and close loop systems, Practical applications of mechatronics, Mechatronics approach. Basics of Digital Technology: Electronic Components & Devices, Number System, Logic gates, Boolean algebra, Logic Functions, Applications.

syllabus.title: Sensors and Transducers; Pneumatic and Hydraulic Actuation Systems
syllabus.body: Sensors and transducers: Introduction, performance terminology-Displacement, Position and Proximity, Velocity and motion, force, Fluid Pressure-Temperature Sensors-Light Sensors-Selection of Sensors-Signal Processing. Pneumatic and Hydraulic actuation systems: Actuation systems, Pneumatic and hydraulic systems, directional control valves, pressure control valves, cylinders, process control valves, rotary actuators.

syllabus.title: Mechanical Actuation Systems; Microprocessor
syllabus.body: Mechanical actuation systems: Mechanical systems, types of motion, kinematics chains, cams, gear trains, ratchet and pawl, belt and chain drives, bearings, mechanical aspects of motor selection. Microprocessor: Introduction, Architecture, Pin Configuration, Instruction set, Programming of Microprocessors using 8085 instructions-Interfacing input and output devices-Interfacing D/A converters and A/D converters, Applications, Temperature control, Stepper motor control.

syllabus.title: Programmable Logic Controller; Robotics
syllabus.body: Programmable Logic Controller: Introduction, Basic structure, Input/output Processing, Programming, Mnemonics, Timers, Internal relays and counters, Data handling, Analog Input/Output, Selection of a PLC. Robotics: Introduction, types of robots, Robotic control, Robot drive systems Robot end effectors, selection parameters of a robot, applications.

outcomes: Understand the basic concepts of mechatronics, digital technology and their applications.
Understand the functioning of various types of sensors, transducers and their applications.
Understand the concept of pneumatic, hydraulic and mechanical actuation systems.
Perceive the functioning of microprocessors, Programmable logic controllers, their architecture, structure and applications.
Understand the basics of robotics, robot types, their drive systems and applications.
